pool.text: An internal uprising in the Khmer outpost of Sukhothai expelled the Khmer overlords.
Xieng Dong Xieng Thong became the capital of the Lan Xang kingdom.
The Khmer king from Angkor gave the Phra Bang to Fa Ngum.
Luang Prabang was occupied by Vietnamese forces during Emperor Le Thanh Tong's expedition.
Lan Xang fell apart and Luang Prabang became the capital of Luang Phrabang.
The Vichy French controlled the city and lost it following the Franco-Thai War.
A nationalist group declared Laos independent with Luang Prabang as its capital.
The French attempted to recapture Laos by using paratroops to retake Luang Prabang.
The Viet Minh and Pathet Lao forces attempted to capture the city.
The city was designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site for blending architecture.
